scripts.build: pnpm codegen && pnpm --filter @calendar/api-contract build && pnpm --filter @calendar/frontend build && pnpm --filter @calendar/backend build
scripts.dev: pnpm codegen && pnpm --filter @calendar/api-contract build && pnpm --parallel --filter @calendar/backend --filter @calendar/frontend dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @calendar/api-contract build && pnpm --filter @calendar/backend build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm codegen && pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
